verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair automation question for an agent-extension ecosystem, but nothing in the evidence documents recurring schedules, cron-style triggers, or timed workflows for Skills. Skills are only invoked on demand (`/skill-name`) or loaded automatically when relevant. The background sessions shown in agent view are one-off runs, not a recurring schedule, so they don't count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
